Mixed purées

Plum and peach with yogurt

Szilvás barack joghurttal

6 months+ Sound idea 20 min 2 portions

Stir and serve the same day. This contains milk.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 2 ripe plums (pitted and peeled)
  • 1 ripe peach (pitted and peeled)
  • 120 g plain pasteurised full-fat yogurt (milk allergen)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Cut the plum and peach flesh off the stones and throw the stones away.
  2. Peel the fruit.
  3. Steam until soft, about 8 minutes, then blend smooth.
  4. Cool until warm and stir into the yogurt.
  5. Run a spoon through to catch any bit of stone.
  6. Do not add sugar.

Sound idea

The stones are the hazard. Flavoured yogurt often contains added sugar.

Pit and peel the plum and peach, cook and blend them, and stir them into plain pasteurised full-fat yogurt. No other change is needed.
